data.one_liner: A Dart library providing random data generation utilities for Flutter and Dart projects
data.what_it_does: It offers functions to generate random names, colors, UUIDs, credit card numbers, SSNs, user details, and more. The API is simple and stateless, returning values directly.
use_when: You need quick random data for testing or demo purposes
You want a single dependency for various random utilities
You prefer a lightweight, pure Dart implementation
avoid_when: You require a comprehensive data mocking framework with fixtures
You are building a production-grade data generator with validation
strengths: All-in-one random utilities in one package
weaknesses: No official support for custom data schemas
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import 'package:random_x/random_x.dart';
